Build a configuration for the generic curation services.

Source: R/curation_config.R
curation_config.Rd

All policy and identity inputs are required. The constructor does not read environment variables or options and does not install a project default, so independent configurations can coexist in one R process.

Usage

curation_config(
  project_id,
  corpus_id,
  config_id,
  topics,
  labels,
  lexicon,
  select_fn,
  selection_controls,
  funnel_stages,
  branding,
  artifact_paths,
  translator = NULL
)

Arguments

project_id, corpus_id, config_id

Explicit curation, corpus, and versioned-configuration identifiers.

topics

Named topic vector used by the caller's scoring workflow.

labels

Named classifier-label vector. An optional relevant attribute must contain only label names.

lexicon

Named list of keyword vectors.

select_fn

Function accepting records and controls, returning a same-row data frame with a logical selected column.

selection_controls

Named list of caller-supplied policy controls.

funnel_stages

Non-empty list of {key, label, fn} entries. Each fn accepts records and context and returns a logical stage mask.

branding

Explicit named branding values, including title and primary. Optional secondary, success, bootswatch, and border_radius values configure the app theme. Supplying both secondary and success enables a three-colour navbar gradient.

artifact_paths

Explicit named artifact paths, including root.

translator

Optional curation_translation_provider; NULL is valid.

Value

A planscanR_curation_config object.
